newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde April 30.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde April 30.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- Britain's Labour party leader Tony Blair about to put an end to 18 years of Conservative rule in Thursday's parliamentary election.
-- Businessman Edouard Stern to leave banque Lazard and create investment firm with a 3.5 billion francs capital.
-- Airline Euralair in a critical situation due to heavy debts.
-- Postal service La Poste posts 1996 net loss of 614 million francs, expects to break even by end 1997.
-- France Telecom telecommunications operator faces loss of international revenues from customers using the Internet, study shows.
-- Elf pharmaceutical subsidiary Sanofi sold U.S. based generic injectable drugs activities to U.S. group Abbott for 1.2 billion francs.
